d: Every great delivery experience starts behind the scenes. As a LiveOps Executive at Snoonu, you’ll be the operational heartbeat keeping our delivery network alive across Oman. You’ll work at the intersection of riders, merchants, and technology, making real-time decisions that directly shape what customers feel on the other end.
q: 0–2 years of experience in operations, logistics, last-mile delivery, or a fast-paced coordination role.
Strong organisational skills — you can juggle multiple moving parts without losing sight of priorities.
Clear, confident communicator, comfortable working with field teams, partners, and internal stakeholders alike.
Comfortable working with data: able to read dashboards, maintain trackers, and flag anomalies quickly.
Problem-solver proactive mindset: you don't wait for someone else to fix an issue; you own it and escalate when needed.
Fluent in English and Arabic given the operational context across Oman.
Prior experience in food delivery, ride-hailing, or a super app environment.
Familiarity with dispatch tools, fleet management systems, or Google Maps / KML zone mapping.
Basic knowledge of Omanisation regulations and 3PL compliance frameworks.
Any additional language is win! (Urdu, Hindi, French, SQL)

r: Monitor live delivery operations across Omani cities, tracking order flows, rider availability, and zone coverage in real time.
Coordinate daily with 3PL (third-party logistics) partners to ensure rider deployment aligns with demand forecasts.
Identify and escalate operational issues — from merchant downtime to delivery delays — and drive swift resolution.
Support new city and zone launches by running pre-launch readiness checks and Go/No-Go assessments.
Track and report on key operational KPIs (CPO, on-time rate, rider utilisation) on a daily and weekly basis.
Provide back-end merchant support from an operational standpoint — resolving order flow issues, account access problems, and menu or availability discrepancies that affect live service.
Troubleshoot and follow up on merchant device issues (tablets, printers, connectivity), coordinating with the tech team to minimise downtime and keep merchants live.

Responsible for maintaining and monitoring Modon’s IT infrastructure, including computer systems and networks. The role supports end users, the data centre, and critical business systems by installing and configuring hardware and software, troubleshooting technical issues, and resolving system, network, and hardware faults efficiently under the guidance of the Manager, Digital & Technology.
q: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent.
3 years of experience in a similar role within the UAE.

Basic knowledge in at least three of the following: end-user computer device hardware; common ‘off the shelf’ software; end-point security technologies; device networking (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi), Active Directory and Group Policy; mobility and remote access technologies; virtualization technologies.
General understanding of infrastructure design, development, and deployment.
Certifications/accreditations in IT is a plus.
Previous experience in real estate companies is a plus.
Ability to communicate in an effective manner with others, both verbally and in writing.
Strong technical expertise and investigation skills.
Good working-level knowledge and expertise with standard concepts, practices, and procedures of software development.

r: Install and update operating systems and related company software.
Diagnose software, hardware, and network errors, and resolve issues within the shortest possible time.
Install, configure, and troubleshoot all technology-related devices, including printers, scanners, and desk phones.
Assist Modon’s end users in person and remotely, as needed.
Monitor the data center facility and the processing of critical systems and servers.
Document and report all necessary activities to the IT Manager.
Perform the required imaging and backups on a regular basis to prevent data from being lost or damaged.
Support and liaise with vendors on hardware or software fixes.

d: Experience: 7+ years in Guest Room Management Systems (GRMS)
q: Strong hands-on experience in Guest Room Management Systems (GRMS) within hospitality projects.
Good understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, virtualization, cloud platforms, and system integration.
Experience in managing end-to-end project execution for hotels, including design review, implementation, testing, commissioning, and handover.
Ability to coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, system integrators, and internal teams.
Experience leading project engineers and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Degree/Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Electronics & Communication, or related field.
Strong project management and leadership skills.
Good knowledge of TCP/IP networking, switches, VLANs, servers, virtualization, and cloud technologies, Putty, SSH, command-line troubleshooting, and basic Linux/Windows server administration.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools .
r: Manage the complete lifecycle of GRMS projects from award to handover.
Act as the primary technical and project management contact for customers and stakeholders.
Plan, monitor, and control project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, and resources.
Coordinate GRMS integration with BMS, PMS, IPTV, networking, servers, and cloud-based platforms.
Review technical designs, ensure system compliance, and oversee testing and commissioning activities.
Lead project meetings, mock-ups, site inspections, and progress reviews.
Manage project documentation, reporting, and customer communications.
Provide technical guidance and training to customers and internal teams.
Travel to project sites as required.
